scope_limit: Sophia Supervisor is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing supplied supervision milestones, manuscript or proposal evidence, source-support records, feedback issues and declared gaps for authorised human supervision review. It does not decide progression, examination outcomes, academic-integrity findings, supervisor sign-off, or degree award.
review_pack_title: DIO Sophia Supervisor Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Student progression, examination outcomes, academic-integrity findings, supervisor sign-off, degree decisions and final release remain with authorised supervisors, examiners and institutions.
